title: Vendor Signup Page — Full UI
desc: Build the vendor signup page in Next.js. Form fields: full name, business name, phone (with +92 prefix and validation), email, password with strength meter, category dropdown, terms & privacy checkbox. Include social signup buttons (Google, Facebook). Design must follow the 3D premium tokens from A1's design system. Loading, error, and success states all designed. Show OTP verification step immediately after phone submission.
acceptance: All form validations trigger inline errors; password meter shows weak/medium/strong; social buttons render; terms link opens modal; page is fully responsive on 1280px+ and mobile; matches design tokens.

title: Vendor Login Page + Forgot Password Flow — UI
desc: Build vendor login page with email-or-phone + password fields. Add 'Remember me' checkbox. 'Forgot password' link opens a modal where vendor enters email → receives reset link → clicks link → new password page. Design the three screens (login, forgot-modal, reset) with consistent styling. Support Google/Facebook social login buttons here too.
acceptance: Wrong credentials show inline error; social login redirects correctly; forgot-password flow works end-to-end; reset link expires visually after 1 hour.

title: 4-Step Onboarding Wizard — Full UI Layer
desc: Build a full-screen 4-step wizard shown after signup: (1) Welcome + business info form (name, category, target region, expected products); (2) Product prompt input ('What do you sell?' with example prompts below); (3) Theme selection — display 4-6 AI-generated theme previews in a grid, vendor picks one; (4) Add first product + celebration. Include a progress bar (25/50/75/100%) at the top, back/next buttons with proper state preservation, and skip options where allowed.
acceptance: All 4 steps navigate correctly; progress bar updates; back preserves state; wizard remembers where user left off if they close/reopen.

title: Onboarding Progress Persistence UI
desc: If a vendor abandons the wizard midway, when they log back in, show a 'Continue onboarding' banner on the dashboard that resumes them at the exact step they left. Also build a 'Complete your setup' checklist widget on the dashboard for post-onboarding items (add 3 more products, connect domain, add courier).
acceptance: Resume flow works from any step; checklist accurately reflects vendor progress; ticking off items updates instantly.

title: Business Profile Settings Page — UI
desc: Full profile settings page split into tabs: Business Info (name, category, description, address, phone, business email, logo upload to Cloudinary), Notification Preferences (toggles for order alerts, low stock, new campaign, WhatsApp forwards, marketing tips), Team Members (list + invite by email with Admin/Editor/Viewer role), Security (change password, active sessions, logout everywhere).
acceptance: All 4 tabs functional; logo upload works and appears in storefront header; team invites send email; changing password logs out other sessions.

title: Subscription Plans Page — UI
desc: Show 3 plan cards side-by-side (Starter / Growth / Scale) with feature comparison, current plan highlighted with a badge, upgrade/downgrade CTAs. Include a FAQ accordion below and a 'contact sales' link for custom enterprise plans. Also show a billing history table below plans.
acceptance: Cards render correctly; features accurate; current plan clearly marked; CTA opens the payment/top-up flow; billing history loads.

title: PKR Wallet Top-Up Flow — UI
desc: Wallet top-up modal: vendor enters amount, selects gateway (JazzCash / EasyPaisa / Bank Transfer), clicks 'Top Up' → redirected to gateway → returns to success or failure page. Show a 'digital invoice' option too where they get a payment link.
acceptance: Redirect works; success updates wallet balance instantly; failure gives clear retry option; digital invoice link shareable.

title: Supabase Auth Setup — Vendors Table + JWT Config
desc: Configure Supabase Auth for email/password + phone OTP. Create the `vendors` table (id, name, business_name, phone, email, category, region, status, created_at, updated_at) with proper indexes. Set JWT expiry to 1 hour with refresh token rotation. Create Row Level Security (RLS) policies so a vendor can only read/update their own row.
acceptance: JWT issued on login; refresh works silently; RLS policies pass unit tests; vendor cannot query another vendor's row.

title: OAuth Integration (Google + Facebook)
desc: Wire Google and Facebook OAuth via Supabase Auth. Handle callback URL, extract profile (email, name, avatar), auto-create vendor row on first login, link existing vendor if email matches. Handle edge cases: email already registered with password auth (offer to link), Facebook email missing (fallback to prompt).
acceptance: OAuth login end-to-end works; existing users not duplicated; missing-email fallback works; audit log entry created for every OAuth login.

title: Phone OTP Verification via WhatsApp Business API
desc: Send a 6-digit OTP to vendor's phone via WhatsApp Business API (cheaper than SMS). Store OTP hashed in DB with 5-minute expiry. Verify endpoint compares hash. Block phone after 3 failed attempts for 15 minutes.
acceptance: OTP delivers within 10 seconds; wrong code blocks after 3 tries; expiry works; audit log for every attempt.

title: Password Reset Flow — Token & Email Trigger
desc: Backend endpoint for password reset: /api/auth/reset-request generates a secure random token, stores it hashed with 1-hour expiry, fires an email via Resend to the vendor. /api/auth/reset-confirm verifies the token and updates the password hash. Old password immediately invalidated after reset.
acceptance: Full flow works; token single-use; expired tokens rejected with clear error; old sessions invalidated after reset.

title: Onboarding State Machine + APIs
desc: Backend to manage onboarding progress: /api/onboarding/step endpoint accepts step data and persists to the `vendor_onboarding` table. Fields: current_step, business_info_data, product_prompt, chosen_theme_id, first_product_id, completed_at. Emits event `onboarding_completed` when step 4 done, which triggers welcome email and Meta pixel install prompt.
acceptance: State survives crash/refresh; event fires exactly once; API idempotent per step.

title: Team Members & Role-Based Access — Backend
desc: Build `team_members` table (id, vendor_id, invited_email, role, status, invited_at, joined_at). API endpoints for invite/accept/revoke. Enforce role-based access in RLS: Admin (full), Editor (products + orders), Viewer (read-only). Invite email sent via Resend.
acceptance: Invite email delivers; roles enforced by RLS on every table; revoke immediately blocks access.

title: Subscription Plans + Recurring Deduction Logic
desc: Backend to manage vendor subscriptions: `subscriptions` table (vendor_id, plan_id, status, current_period_start, current_period_end, next_charge_at, cancel_at_period_end). Scheduled cron (daily) that deducts monthly fee from wallet. On failure: 3-day grace period + email reminders; then suspend features until paid.
acceptance: Recurring deduction runs on schedule; failed renewals get grace period; feature-flag system correctly gates features when suspended.

title: Invoice PDF Generation
desc: For every successful subscription payment, generate a PDF invoice (using React-PDF or Puppeteer) with vendor's business info, plan details, tax breakdown (Pakistan sales tax if applicable), and DigiShop AI header. Store in Supabase Storage; expose via signed URL. Email attached copy to vendor.
acceptance: PDF renders correctly with vendor branding; download works; signed URL expires after 24 hours.

title: V1 E2E Test Suite — Auth + Onboarding + Profile
desc: Write Playwright end-to-end tests covering: (1) full signup → OTP → onboarding → dashboard; (2) OAuth signup + link to existing account; (3) forgot password flow with email verification; (4) team member invite + accept; (5) subscription upgrade + downgrade; (6) wallet top-up success and failure.
acceptance: All 6 flows pass on CI in <5 minutes; screenshots captured for review; 80%+ code coverage on V1 files.

title: Vendor Dashboard Layout — Sidebar + Navbar + Content
desc: Build the vendor dashboard shell: collapsible left sidebar with icons + labels (Dashboard, Products, Orders, Analytics, Campaigns, Wallet, Domain, Storefront, Settings), top navbar with global search + notification bell (unread badge) + profile avatar dropdown (Profile, Settings, Logout), and a main content area with breadcrumbs. All using 3D premium design tokens. Responsive down to 1280px minimum; mobile menu hamburger below that.
acceptance: All 9 sidebar links route correctly; active state visible; navbar dropdown works; notification bell shows unread count from API; mobile hamburger works.

title: Dashboard Home — KPI Cards Row
desc: Top row of 4 KPI cards on dashboard home: Total Sales Today (₨), Orders Today (count), Site Views (count), Conversion Rate (%). Each card includes a 7-day sparkline showing trend, plus % change vs previous 7 days (green up, red down). Skeleton loaders while fetching.
acceptance: Cards render with real data; sparklines correct; % change accurate; skeletons show while loading; cards animate on data change.

title: Recent Orders + Quick Actions Widgets
desc: Below KPIs: (a) 'Recent Orders' table showing last 10 with customer, amount, status pill, click → order details; (b) 'Quick Actions' card with buttons for common tasks (Add Product, Launch Ad, Top-Up Wallet, Reply to WhatsApp queries — with badge count).
acceptance: Table paginates; row click navigates correctly; quick action buttons deep-link to correct pages.

title: Full Analytics Page — Filters, Charts & Insights
desc: Dedicated /analytics page with date range picker (Today, 7d, 30d, 90d, custom) at the top. Sections: (1) Traffic overview — total visits, unique visitors, session duration; (2) Geographical heatmap of Pakistan with city-level visitor concentration; (3) Traffic source donut chart (Meta Ads, WhatsApp, Organic, Direct); (4) New vs Returning customer bar chart; (5) Conversion funnel (visited → viewed product → added cart → purchased); (6) Device split pie (Mobile vs Desktop) + Top 5 products by time spent.
acceptance: All 6 sections render; date range updates all; heatmap interactive; funnel drop-off percentages visible; charts responsive.

title: Live Site Activity Widget (Real-Time)
desc: Small floating widget or dashboard card that shows currently active visitors and current page they're on, updated in real time via Supabase Realtime subscription. Show visitor count with pulse animation on change. Toggle to hide.
acceptance: Count updates in real time without page reload; pulse animation smooth; toggle preference saved to profile.

title: Public Storefront Layout Shell (SSR)
desc: Build the Next.js SSR layout for the vendor's public storefront (visible to their customers, not vendor). Header with vendor logo, categories nav, search bar, cart icon; main slot; footer with policies + social links. Rendered server-side per vendor domain/subdomain. Layout picks up vendor's theme tokens.
acceptance: SSR works; per-vendor branding injected correctly; Lighthouse Performance ≥85 and SEO ≥95 on affected pages; no layout shift.

title: Storefront Homepage — Hero, Featured Products, Categories
desc: Build the homepage template rendered on vendor's public site. Sections: (1) Hero banner (image/video + headline + CTA, configurable per vendor); (2) Featured products grid (auto-picks best-sellers or vendor-featured); (3) Category tiles; (4) Newsletter signup; (5) Trust panel row (Secured Checkout, COD, Fast Delivery). All theme-token-driven.
acceptance: All sections render for any vendor; images optimized via Cloudinary; SSR outputs valid HTML; mobile perfect.

title: Storefront Category Landing Pages + Search Results
desc: Build /category/[slug] pages with product grid + filters sidebar (price range slider, variant checkboxes, sort dropdown). Also build /search page consuming search backend. Both SEO-optimized with per-category meta tags.
acceptance: Filters update results without full reload; sort works; empty state clear; each page has unique title/description.

title: AI Theme Rebranding Prompt Interface
desc: In vendor dashboard under /storefront/theme, provide an interface where vendor types a style prompt ('modern minimal', 'aggressive sports look', 'luxurious gold accents'). Show before/after live preview side-by-side. Vendor can accept, retry with new prompt, or manually tweak specific tokens (color picker, font selector).
acceptance: Preview updates in <3s after AI response; before/after comparison clear; accept saves to DB and reflects on storefront within 30s.

title: Storefront Preview Modal (Live in Dashboard)
desc: Whenever vendor changes theme, products, or homepage sections, they can click 'Preview Storefront' to see the live public storefront in an iframe modal (desktop and mobile view toggles). Include a 'copy shareable link' button.
acceptance: Preview loads in <2s; toggle between desktop/mobile viewports works; share link opens in new tab correctly.

title: Analytics Data Model + Aggregation Views
desc: Design Supabase tables: `page_views` (vendor_id, session_id, page, city, country, device, referrer, timestamp), `sessions` (session_id, vendor_id, customer_id, started_at, ended_at). Create materialized views for common aggregations (daily_summary, geo_heatmap, source_attribution) refreshed every 5 minutes to keep queries fast. Add proper indexes.
acceptance: Materialized views refresh on schedule; queries return in <200ms on 100k+ rows; RLS enforced.

title: Analytics API Endpoints (5 Routes)
desc: Build /api/analytics/summary (KPI cards data), /api/analytics/traffic (daily traffic with source breakdown), /api/analytics/geo (city heatmap data), /api/analytics/funnel (conversion funnel), /api/analytics/devices (device + top products). All protected by JWT + return 401 for wrong vendor. Support date range query params.
acceptance: All 5 endpoints return correct JSON; respond in <500ms; 401 for unauthorized; unit tests pass.

title: Client-Side Tracking Script (Storefront Beacon)
desc: Build a lightweight (< 5KB) JavaScript beacon injected into every storefront page that sends page_view events (with device, city via GeoIP, referrer, session, product context if PDP) to /api/track. Debounced to avoid overload. Respects Do Not Track.
acceptance: Beacon script loads async, doesn't block page render; events land in DB; GDPR opt-out respected.

title: Multi-Tenant Storefront Routing (Domain → Vendor)
desc: Middleware in Next.js that resolves incoming domain/subdomain (e.g., www.brandxyz.com or brandxyz.digishop.com) to a vendor_id. Uses `domains` table (domain, vendor_id, verified, ssl_status). Caches lookup for 60s. Falls through 404 if unknown domain.
acceptance: Domain lookup <20ms via cache; correct vendor loaded for every request; unknown domain returns proper 404.

title: SEO Meta Tags + Sitemap.xml + Robots.txt Generation
desc: For every storefront page, dynamically generate <title>, meta description, Open Graph, Twitter Card, canonical URL, structured data (JSON-LD for Product/Offer/Organization/BreadcrumbList). Also auto-generate /sitemap.xml per vendor domain listing all products + categories with lastmod dates. Serve /robots.txt with sensible defaults.
acceptance: Google Rich Results test passes; sitemap accessible and valid XML; robots.txt served correctly.

title: AI Theme Rebranding Service
desc: Build /api/theme/rebrand endpoint: takes vendor prompt + selected base theme, calls LLM with a strict output schema (colors, fonts, radii, spacings), validates output, persists to `theme_tokens` table keyed by vendor_id. Uses smart token optimization — only sends theme schema + prompt, not full site code (per blueprint §9.3).
acceptance: New tokens saved; storefront reflects change on next request; average LLM cost per rebrand <$0.05; cost tracked per call.

title: Theme Token Injection at SSR + Cache Layer
desc: During storefront SSR, fetch vendor's theme tokens from `theme_tokens` and inject as CSS variables in the root <html> tag. Cache per vendor with 5-min TTL, invalidated whenever vendor changes theme. Fall back to default theme if tokens missing.
acceptance: Tokens injected correctly on every request; cache hit rate >95%; no flash of unstyled content (FOUC); fallback works.

title: Storefront Search Backend (Postgres Full-Text)
desc: Build /api/storefront/search endpoint using Postgres full-text search + trigram similarity for typo tolerance. Search across product name, description, tags, category. Rank by relevance + recent sales. Scoped to the current vendor's domain.
acceptance: Search returns relevant results in <200ms on 10k products; typos still match; ranking sensible in test cases.

title: V2 Test Suite — Analytics + Storefront + Theme
desc: Jest tests for analytics aggregation math. Playwright E2E: (1) full dashboard load with real data; (2) filter analytics by date range; (3) rebrand storefront via prompt and verify change on public site; (4) storefront SEO — Lighthouse SEO score ≥95.
acceptance: All 4 flows pass on CI; Lighthouse SEO ≥95; 80%+ coverage on V2 files.

title: Product Listing Page — Table View + Filters
desc: Build /products page: table showing all vendor's products with columns (thumbnail, name, SKU, price, stock, category, status, last updated, actions). Above table: search box, category filter, status filter (published/draft/out-of-stock), sort dropdown. Bulk select via checkboxes with bulk actions bar (delete, change category, mark draft/published).
acceptance: Table paginates 20 per page; renders 5k+ products smoothly (virtualized if needed); search/filter/sort all work; bulk actions confirm before executing.

title: Add / Edit Product Form — Multi-Tab Layout
desc: Full product form with 4 tabs: (1) Basic — title, description (rich text), category, tags, brand; (2) Pricing — price, compare-at-price, cost, tax; (3) Variants — variant options (size/color/etc.) with matrix generation, per-variant price + stock + SKU; (4) Media — 5-image uploader + AI generation button; (5) SEO — meta title, description, URL slug. Save as draft or publish. Auto-save every 30s.
acceptance: All 5 tabs functional; validations block invalid submission; auto-save works; navigating away with unsaved changes warns.

title: Product Image Uploader (Drag-and-Drop, Up to 5)
desc: Rich image uploader area: drag-and-drop 1-5 images at once, live thumbnails in a reorderable grid (drag to reorder), delete button per image, primary image indicator. Show upload progress bar per image. Each image uploaded directly to Cloudinary via signed URL.
acceptance: Upload succeeds up to 5; reorder saves; delete removes from Cloudinary too; primary indicator swaps.

title: AI Image Generation Modal
desc: Button 'Generate images with AI' on product form opens a modal: vendor confirms product description + selects style (studio white bg / lifestyle / flat lay / dark moody), clicks Generate. Shows loading state, then a 4-image grid to pick from. Vendor selects one or more → they get added to product images.
acceptance: Modal opens; images generate in <15s; selection adds to product uploader; regenerate button works with a different seed.

title: AI Copywriting UI (Title + Description)
desc: Inline 'Write with AI' button next to title and description fields. Clicking opens a small popover: vendor types product name/keywords, selects tone (Professional / Friendly / Luxurious / Playful), clicks Generate. Shows 3 title options and 3 description options — vendor picks one for each, or regenerates.
acceptance: AI generates within 5s; SEO title ≤60 chars; descriptions have proper structure (hook + features + CTA).

title: Variants Matrix Builder — UI
desc: In the Variants tab: vendor adds option types (e.g., Size with values S/M/L, Color with values Red/Blue) → matrix auto-generates all combinations (S/Red, S/Blue, M/Red, ...). For each row: SKU, price, stock, image (optional), enable/disable toggle. Bulk-set price/stock across all variants.
acceptance: Matrix generates correctly for 2 and 3 option types; bulk-set works; disabled variants hidden on storefront.

title: Smart Inventory Screen with Instant Update Pop-Up
desc: Build /inventory page: dense, spreadsheet-like table of all products+variants with columns (image, name, SKU, price, stock, low-stock threshold). Click any editable cell (price, stock, threshold) → inline pop-up to edit → save without leaving the list. Uses optimistic UI (updates instantly, rolls back on server error). Keyboard shortcuts: Enter saves, Esc cancels, arrow keys navigate cells.
acceptance: Edits save in <500ms; keyboard shortcuts work; optimistic rollback on error visible; feature saves vendor 80% of time (measured).

title: Bulk Inventory Actions + CSV Import/Export
desc: Above inventory table: bulk actions bar (bulk edit price/stock, bulk disable, bulk export). Add 'Import from CSV' button — vendor uploads CSV, sees preview table with validation errors highlighted, confirms import. Also 'Export to CSV' downloads current filtered view.
acceptance: CSV import handles 5k rows in <30s; validation errors clear; export includes all filtered products.

title: Products Data Model + CRUD API
desc: Design `products` table (id, vendor_id, title, description, category_id, tags[], price, compare_price, cost, seo_slug, seo_title, seo_description, status, created_at, updated_at) and `product_variants` (id, product_id, sku, option_values, price, stock, image_url, enabled). Add proper RLS so vendors only access their own. Build REST + GraphQL endpoints for CRUD.
acceptance: All CRUD endpoints work; RLS enforced; queries fast (<200ms P95); indexes on vendor_id + status + category_id.

title: Cloudinary Signed Upload Integration
desc: Backend endpoint /api/cloudinary/sign that generates signed upload URLs (with vendor_id folder + max file size + allowed types). Frontend uploads directly to Cloudinary (never through our server). After upload, image URL saved to product. Auto-set WebP/AVIF format + quality auto + width limits (max 2000px).
acceptance: Signed URLs generated correctly; direct upload works; images auto-optimized; folder structure prevents vendor collisions.

title: AI Image Generation Backend Service
desc: Wraps chosen image gen provider (DALL-E 3 / Stable Diffusion via Replicate). Endpoint /api/ai/generate-images takes product context + style, calls provider, applies NSFW filter, saves 4 results to Cloudinary, returns URLs. Rate-limited per vendor. Tracks cost per call.
acceptance: 4 usable images returned in <15s; NSFW filtered out; cost logged per vendor for later billing.

title: AI Copywriting Backend Service
desc: Endpoint /api/ai/copywriting takes product keywords + tone. Calls LLM with a strict prompt template that includes DigiShop AI's ecommerce best practices (hook first, features as bullets, CTA at end). Returns 3 title + 3 description variants. SEO title enforced ≤60 chars, description ≥120 words.
acceptance: Returns in <5s; character limits respected; token cost <$0.02 per generation; results are on-brand.

title: Inventory Update API (Instant Update)
desc: Endpoints: PATCH /api/inventory/:variant_id (single field update — price, stock, threshold), POST /api/inventory/bulk (bulk updates). Optimistic concurrency (version field). Emits `stock_changed` event for low-stock detection.
acceptance: Instant updates <300ms P95; concurrent edits detected; events fire for low-stock detection.

title: Low-Stock Alert Engine
desc: Background listener on `stock_changed` events. When a variant's stock ≤ its threshold, insert a `notifications` row (vendor_id, type='low_stock', variant_id) + send email via Resend + increment in-app badge count. Deduplicate — only one alert per variant per 24 hours.
acceptance: Alerts fire correctly; email delivers; badge visible in nav; no spam (dedup works).

title: Categories & Tags Backend
desc: Design `categories` table (id, vendor_id, name, parent_id for tree structure, slug, image_url, sort_order). Endpoints for CRUD. Support up to 3-level nesting. Automatic slug generation from name. `tags` handled as text[] on products with GIN index for fast search.
acceptance: Categories nest properly; slug uniqueness enforced per vendor; tag search fast (<100ms).

title: Bulk CSV Import + Export Backend
desc: Endpoints /api/products/import-csv (upload CSV, validate every row against schema, return errors OR create products transactionally) and /api/products/export-csv (streams CSV of filtered products). Import supports up to 5k rows per file.
acceptance: 5k-row import completes in <30s; all-or-nothing transaction; export streams without OOM.

title: V3 Test Suite — Products + AI Tools + Inventory
desc: Unit tests for product CRUD, variants matrix logic, CSV parser. Playwright E2E: add-product with AI image + AI copy end-to-end, bulk inventory update, CSV import.
acceptance: All flows pass; 80%+ coverage on V3 files; performance test — 1k products loads in <1s.

title: Vendor Order Management Log
desc: Build /orders page in vendor dashboard: table of all orders (order#, customer, total, payment status, delivery status, date, actions). Filters: status, payment method, date range, delivery method. Bulk export to CSV. Real-time badge for new orders (Supabase Realtime).
acceptance: Table paginates; filters work; new orders appear without refresh; export works.

title: Order Detail View + Actions
desc: Order detail page: line items grid, customer info card, payment breakdown, delivery tracking, event timeline (paid → confirmed → shipped → delivered), action buttons (Mark Shipped, Cancel, Issue Refund, Contact Customer via WhatsApp). Print packing slip button.
acceptance: All actions functional; timeline shows real events; refund triggers A2 escrow release; packing slip PDF opens.

title: Product Detail Page (PDP) — Full Layout
desc: Public PDP customers see: image gallery (with zoom + video support), title, price, variant selectors, add-to-cart button, description tabs, related products carousel, trust badges panel, Secured Checkout badge, WhatsApp chat widget. Sticky add-to-cart on mobile scroll.
acceptance: PDP renders for all product types; variant switching updates price/image/stock; mobile perfect.

title: Cart Drawer + Full Cart Page
desc: Slide-out cart drawer accessible from every page (right side): line items, qty controls, subtotal, checkout CTA. Separate /cart page for larger review: coupon code entry, delivery estimate, related products, proceed to checkout. Persistent across pages.
acceptance: Drawer smooth; qty updates instantly; totals recalculate; coupon validation works.

title: Checkout Flow — Multi-Step UI
desc: 3-step checkout on storefront: (1) Contact + Shipping (autofill from customer account if logged in); (2) Payment method (COD / Bank / Card via gateway / Secured Checkout escrow) — show fees per method; (3) Review + Place Order. Order summary sidebar visible throughout. Support guest checkout.
acceptance: All 3 steps navigate correctly; guest checkout works; account customer sees pre-filled; correct fees shown per method.

title: Thank-You / Order Confirmation Page
desc: Post-checkout success page: order number, order summary, delivery ETA, WhatsApp tracking link, share buttons (WhatsApp/Facebook), sign-up prompt for guests. Fire GA/Meta pixel purchase event.
acceptance: Page renders correctly; tracking link works; pixel fires with correct value; guest signup adds account to their order.

title: Meta Ads Campaign List + Detail Page
desc: Vendor /campaigns page: table of campaigns (name, product, budget, status, impressions, CTR, ROAS, actions). Detail page: performance charts over time, best-performing creatives, cost breakdown, pause/resume/edit.
acceptance: Table and charts render with live data from Meta API; actions call correct backend routes.

title: One-Click Ad Launch Wizard
desc: Modal wizard on /campaigns/new: (1) Select product; (2) AI generates 3 ad copy variants — vendor picks/edits; (3) AI picks targeting (age, gender, city, interests) — vendor can adjust; (4) Set budget + duration; (5) Preview + Launch. Uses vendor's VCC as payment method.
acceptance: Wizard flows correctly; AI copy loads; ad successfully launches on Meta sandbox; VCC used as payment.

title: Email Marketing Dashboard
desc: Vendor /email page: pre-built campaign templates (Abandoned Cart, Post-Purchase Thanks, Win-back, Seasonal Discount). Each shows preview + one-click activate + performance stats (sent, opened, clicked, converted).
acceptance: Templates render; activate/deactivate saves; stats update from Resend webhook.

title: Wallet Dashboard + VCC Card View
desc: Vendor /wallet page: prominent balance card, top-up button, VCC card view (masked with 'reveal' button + copy to clipboard), transactions table (filter by type: top-up / subscription / VCC funding / refund).
acceptance: Balance accurate; VCC masked by default; reveal requires password re-confirmation; transactions filter works.

title: VCC Generation & Top-Up Flow
desc: Modal: (1) 'Generate VCC' — confirm identity (KYC re-check if needed) → progress spinner → success screen with VCC details + step-by-step 'How to add to Meta Ads' guide with screenshots. (2) Separate VCC top-up flow — vendor moves money from wallet to VCC.
acceptance: VCC generates via bank API; onboarding guide clear; top-up updates VCC balance in real time.

title: Orders Data Model + State Machine
desc: Design `orders` (id, vendor_id, customer_id, total, currency, payment_method, payment_status, delivery_status, escrow_status, created_at) + `order_items` (order_id, product_id, variant_id, qty, unit_price). State machine: pending → paid → confirmed → shipped → delivered → completed (with cancelled + refunded branches). Emit event on every transition.
acceptance: State transitions enforce rules (can't skip); events emitted correctly; audit log for every change.

title: Orders CRUD API + Real-Time Updates
desc: REST endpoints for orders list, detail, update status, cancel, refund. Also Supabase Realtime channel per vendor for new-order notifications. Refund endpoint triggers A2's escrow release/refund logic.
acceptance: All endpoints work; Realtime channel delivers within 2s of new order; refund integrates with A2.

title: Cart State Backend (Guest + Logged-In)
desc: For logged-in customers: `carts` table (id, customer_id, vendor_id, items[], updated_at). For guests: signed cookie holding cart. Merge guest cart into customer cart on login. Cart expires after 30 days idle.
acceptance: State survives refresh; merge on login works without duplicates; expired carts cleaned up.

title: PayFast Payment Gateway Integration
desc: Server-side integration with PayFast (Pakistan's popular gateway). Create checkout session, handle redirect, verify webhook signature, mark order paid on success. Full error handling for declines/timeouts.
acceptance: Payment succeeds in sandbox end-to-end; webhook signature verified; declines handled gracefully.

title: Safepay + Stripe Gateway Integrations
desc: Parallel integrations with Safepay (local PK) and Stripe (international). Same webhook pattern. Stripe supports Apple Pay + Google Pay + multi-currency + Link one-tap checkout.
acceptance: Both gateways succeed in sandbox; multi-currency displays; Apple/Google Pay work.

title: COD Order Flow + WhatsApp Verification
desc: When customer selects COD, create order marked 'pending_verification'. Immediately fire a WhatsApp message to customer with a verify link. Only after clicking verify does order enter 'confirmed' state (reducing RTO).
acceptance: Order created; WhatsApp fires within 30s; verify link works and updates state; expired verify links handled.

title: Meta Ads API Integration + Campaign Sync
desc: Full integration with Meta Marketing API v18+. Create campaigns, ad sets, ads, targeting, budgets. Handle OAuth for vendor's Meta Business account. Sync job every 15 min pulls campaign metrics into our DB.
acceptance: Real ad launched successfully in Meta sandbox; sync job runs on schedule; failures retried with backoff.

title: AI Ad Copy + Targeting Backend
desc: /api/marketing/ad-copy: takes product_id, returns 3 ad copy variants using LLM. /api/marketing/targeting: returns AI-suggested targeting (age, gender, cities, interests) based on product category + vendor's existing customer data. Token optimization — send only product + audience context, not entire codebase (per §9.3).
acceptance: 3 variants returned in <5s; targeting suggestions convert (measured via A/B); cost per call <$0.03.

title: Wallet + VCC Data Model + Ledger
desc: Tables: `wallets` (vendor_id, balance, currency), `wallet_transactions` (append-only ledger: type, amount, balance_after, ref_id, created_at). `vcc_cards` (id, vendor_id, bank_ref, masked_pan, balance, status). All balance derivations from ledger.
acceptance: Ledger integrity holds; wallet.balance always == sum of transactions; VCC balance mirrors bank.

title: Partner Bank API Integration for VCC Issuance
desc: Integrate with partner bank's Banking-as-a-Service API (Bank Alfalah or equivalent) to issue Virtual Credit Cards. Handle KYC checks, card lifecycle (issue → active → freeze → close), balance top-up from wallet, webhooks for transactions.
acceptance: Real VCC issued in bank sandbox; can freeze/close via API; top-ups reflected on card within 60s.

title: Wallet Top-Up via Local Gateways
desc: Endpoints to top up wallet via JazzCash, EasyPaisa, Bank Transfer. Each triggers a payment via A2's gateway integrations. On webhook confirmation, credit wallet ledger.
acceptance: Top-ups from each method credit within 60s of payment success; failed payments don't credit.

title: V4 Test Suite — Orders + Checkout + Marketing + Wallet
desc: Playwright E2E: (1) customer places order via COD → verification → vendor sees it; (2) full checkout via PayFast; (3) launch a Meta ad from wizard end-to-end; (4) top-up wallet → generate VCC.
acceptance: All 4 flows pass on CI; wallet ledger integrity verified in test.

title: globals.css + Full Design Token System
desc: Define ALL CSS variables that both Vendor and Admin panels use: color palette (brand, semantic red/green/amber/blue, neutrals with 10 shades each), typography (font families, sizes, line heights, weights), spacing scale (4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64), border radii, shadow presets (including 3D premium shadows per blueprint), z-index scale, breakpoints. Dark mode variants for all.
acceptance: Every team imports from a single source; dark mode toggle works globally; documented in Storybook.

title: Base Component Library (25+ Components)
desc: Build the reusable component library: Button (5 variants), Input, Textarea, Select, Checkbox, Radio, Toggle, Card, Modal, Drawer, Tabs, Stepper, Toast, Skeleton, Avatar, Badge, Table (with sorting/pagination), Chart wrappers (Line/Bar/Donut/Sparkline via Recharts), Tooltip, Popover, MenuDropdown, DatePicker, FileUploader, SearchBar, EmptyState. All accessible (WCAG AA), all documented in Storybook.
acceptance: All 25+ components accessible; Storybook documented; used by every other member; visual regression clean via Chromatic.

title: Admin Panel Layout Shell
desc: Build /admin layout: sidebar with modules (Overview, Vendors, Orders, Escrow, Logistics, Domains, Finance, Emails, Users, Settings, Support Tickets), top bar with global search + admin profile menu, main area with breadcrumbs. Route-protected — only admin roles can access. Distinct visual style from vendor panel (darker theme).
acceptance: Layout renders; RBAC blocks non-admins; distinct admin styling; mobile-adaptive.

title: Admin Overview Dashboard — Platform KPIs
desc: Admin home page showing platform-wide KPIs: total active vendors, total GMV today/this month, escrow balance, pending payouts, top-performing vendors, new signups today. Include charts of GMV over time, signups over time, subscription MRR.
acceptance: All KPIs render from admin analytics API; charts responsive; loads in <2s.

title: Vendors List Page + Filters
desc: /admin/vendors table: business name, owner, plan, GMV, signup date, last active, status, actions. Filters: plan, status (active/suspended), region, category, GMV range, signup range. Bulk actions (send notification, force-suspend, export list).
acceptance: Table renders 10k vendors smoothly (virtualized); filters combine; bulk actions confirmed before executing.

title: Vendor Detail Page — Full Profile View
desc: Vendor detail: profile info, subscription details, activity timeline, revenue chart, escrow held, VCC status, courier connections, campaigns, support tickets. Admin actions: suspend/reactivate, extend trial, adjust plan, refund on behalf, force-logout, view as vendor (impersonate).
acceptance: All sections load; impersonate opens vendor dashboard as them with audit log; suspend blocks vendor's next login.

title: Vendor Support Tickets UI
desc: /admin/support: ticket queue (open/pending/closed), priority sorting, assign to admin, reply thread, close/escalate actions. Attach macros for common replies.
acceptance: Ticket state machine works; assignment works; macros populate correctly.

title: Platform Analytics Dashboard
desc: /admin/analytics: platform-wide metrics — vendor growth (cohort retention), GMV trend, top categories, geographic split, subscription MRR + churn, top vendors by GMV, feature adoption (% using Meta Ads, WhatsApp AI, escrow). Date range filter.
acceptance: All charts render; date range updates all; export to PDF works.

title: Vendors Admin API + RBAC
desc: Endpoints under /api/admin/vendors: list (with filter/sort/paginate), detail, suspend, reactivate, adjust plan, impersonate (returns short-lived JWT for vendor's account with audit log entry). All routes require admin role — checked via middleware.
acceptance: All endpoints work; RBAC enforced; impersonate audit-logged; performance <300ms P95.

title: Admin Users + Role-Based Access Control
desc: Design `admin_users` (id, email, name, role, created_at) with roles: SuperAdmin (all), OpsAdmin (vendor mgmt + support), FinanceAdmin (escrow + finance), SupportAdmin (tickets only). Middleware enforces route access by role. SSO-ready.
acceptance: Roles enforced on every admin route; wrong-role users get 403; SSO integration hook ready.

title: Platform Analytics Aggregation API
desc: Endpoints under /api/admin/analytics/*: platform_kpis, gmv_trend, vendor_growth, top_vendors, feature_adoption, cohort_retention. Uses materialized views refreshed hourly for performance.
acceptance: All endpoints return correct data; queries <500ms; views refresh on schedule.

title: System-Wide Audit Log
desc: Append-only `audit_log` table (id, actor_id, actor_role, action, resource_type, resource_id, before_state, after_state, ip, timestamp). Every admin action + sensitive vendor action logged. Query API for admin panel viewing.
acceptance: Every sensitive action logged; log is tamper-evident (WORM); queryable by resource.

title: Support Tickets Backend
desc: Tables: `tickets` (id, vendor_id, subject, status, priority, assigned_to), `ticket_messages` (ticket_id, sender_type, sender_id, body, attachments). Endpoints for CRUD + assign + reply + close. Email notifications on updates via Resend.
acceptance: Ticket lifecycle works; emails fire on updates; attachments to Cloudinary.

title: In-App Notifications System
desc: Shared notifications backend used by V-side (vendor notifications) and A-side (admin notifications). `notifications` table (id, user_id, user_type, type, payload, read_at). Real-time delivery via Supabase Realtime.
acceptance: Notifications deliver in real time; read state syncs; used by all teams.

title: A1 Test Suite — Design System + Admin + Vendor Mgmt
desc: Storybook visual regression for design system (Chromatic). Jest unit tests for RBAC middleware. Playwright: admin logs in → views vendor list → impersonates a vendor → returns to admin.
acceptance: Design system visual clean; RBAC tests pass; E2E green.

title: Escrow Admin Panel — Held Funds Overview
desc: /admin/escrow page: total held across platform, per-vendor breakdown table (vendor, held amount, oldest order date, pending release), search + filter. Click vendor → drill into their held orders.
acceptance: Totals accurate; drill-down works; performance stays fast at 10k held orders.

title: Escrow Detail + Manual Release/Refund UI
desc: Per-order escrow view: order details, courier tracking, hold reason, release/refund/hold-longer actions. Actions require 2-step confirmation with reason text. Audit log inline.
acceptance: Actions work; confirmation prevents accidents; audit log visible; each action reason required.

title: Disputes Management UI
desc: /admin/disputes queue: customer complaints on orders, evidence (screenshots, chat logs), admin decision UI (release to vendor / refund customer / partial refund). SLA countdown per dispute.
acceptance: Queue prioritized by SLA; decisions logged; parties notified on resolution.

title: Financial Reports Dashboard
desc: /admin/finance: revenue reports (subscription MRR, transaction fees, domain sales, VCC volume), expense reports (LLM costs, Cloudinary, Vercel, Resend, gateway fees), P&L over time. Export to Excel.
acceptance: Reports render accurately; date range works; Excel export includes all data.

title: Vendor Payout Management UI
desc: /admin/payouts page: pending vendor payouts (post-escrow-release), approve individually or bulk, batch-payout button. Payout status tracking (pending / processing / completed / failed).
acceptance: Bulk payouts work; failures visible with reason; retry action available.

title: Subscription Plans Management (Admin)
desc: /admin/plans: CRUD interface for subscription plans (name, price, features JSON, limits, active toggle). Preview how plan looks on vendor's subscription page. Trigger migrations when plans change.
acceptance: Plan changes reflect immediately on vendor side; migrations don't break existing subscriptions.

title: Escrow Ledger (Financial Core)
desc: Append-only `escrow_ledger` (id, order_id, vendor_id, type: hold/release/refund/chargeback, amount, balance_after, ref_id, created_at). Balance derivation per vendor. Reconciliation job daily against gateway settlement reports.
acceptance: Ledger integrity holds mathematically; daily reconciliation matches gateway; discrepancies alert.

title: Automated Escrow Release Logic
desc: Job that scans held orders. Release conditions: delivery confirmed via courier API + no dispute after 3 days. Handle edge cases: partial delivery, delayed delivery (extend hold), dispute (freeze until admin decides).
acceptance: Release fires reliably; no double-release; edge cases handled; audit log entry for every release.

title: Refund Processing Backend
desc: Endpoint POST /api/escrow/refund. If order still in escrow → release refund directly from held funds. If already released → charge vendor's wallet or trigger gateway reverse. Notify customer via WhatsApp + email.
acceptance: Refunds succeed in all 3 scenarios; customer receives money within gateway's SLA; notifications fire.

title: Disputes Data Model + Workflow
desc: `disputes` table (id, order_id, opened_by, reason, evidence[], status, resolution, resolved_by, resolved_at). Workflow: opened → under_review → resolved_release / resolved_refund / resolved_partial. SLA: 48h to first response.
acceptance: State machine correct; SLA countdown accurate; evidence stored securely.

title: Financial Reports Aggregation Backend
desc: Materialized views for revenue (by source: subscription, txn fee, domain, VCC), expenses (from external cost trackers), MRR, ARR, churn. Refreshed hourly. Endpoints for admin dashboard.
acceptance: Reports match manual calculations; endpoints fast; expense data pulled from provider APIs.

title: Vendor Payout Engine
desc: Payouts move released escrow → vendor's bank account (via bank API) or wallet. `payouts` table with state (pending / processing / completed / failed). Batch payout job runs daily. Retry failed with backoff.
acceptance: Payouts land in vendor accounts; failures retryable; ledger balanced.

title: Subscription Plans Admin API + Feature Flag Sync
desc: Endpoints for CRUD on plans. Feature flag system that maps plan_id → allowed features. Vendors on that plan see features gated accordingly on frontend.
acceptance: Feature flags respect plan; changes propagate to vendor within 5 min; downgrade blocks disabled features.

title: A2 Test Suite — Escrow + Finance
desc: Very thorough because this is money. Unit tests for ledger math with 1000+ scenarios. E2E: full order → escrow hold → delivery → auto-release → payout. Chaos tests: what if gateway webhook lost, what if courier misreports.
acceptance: Ledger unit tests pass 100%; E2E green; chaos scenarios recovered gracefully.

title: Admin Logistics Overview
desc: /admin/logistics: platform-wide shipment stats (in transit, delayed, delivered today, RTO rate) by courier partner. Charts for delivery time per courier, failure reasons breakdown.
acceptance: Stats accurate; per-courier drill-down works; charts render.

title: Courier Partners CRUD UI
desc: /admin/couriers: table of courier partners (name, API base URL, active, coverage regions, cost per delivery avg). Add/edit form. Toggle active. Health check status per partner.
acceptance: CRUD works; toggle active immediately affects vendor available options; health status live.

title: Vendor's Courier Setup Aid (Admin Support)
desc: When a vendor needs help onboarding a courier, admin can view their courier config, test their API key, and if needed, remote-fix. Read-only for security.
acceptance: Admin can view config; test button works without saving; changes require vendor approval.

title: Domain Reseller Operations Panel
desc: /admin/domains: platform-wide domain stats (total registered, upcoming renewals, expired, revenue from domains). Table of all vendor domains with search/filter. Actions: force-renew, transfer, retire.
acceptance: Stats and table load; actions require confirmation; audit-logged.

title: Domain Provider Management
desc: /admin/domain-providers: manage upstream registrar accounts (OpenSRS, Enom, Namecheap Reseller). API credentials (encrypted), balance monitoring, TLD pricing config, markup rules.
acceptance: Provider credentials hidden; balance visible; markup rules apply correctly on vendor search.

title: Courier Integration Abstraction Layer
desc: Adapter pattern: `CourierProvider` interface with methods (createWaybill, getStatus, calculateRate). Concrete adapters for TCS, Leopards, Trax, Orio. Vendor selects which one via their API key. Handles auth, rate limits, retries.
acceptance: 3 couriers integrated in sandbox; consistent interface; retries with exponential backoff.

title: Courier API Key Hashing + Vault
desc: Vendor courier API keys encrypted at rest via AES-256-GCM (A4's key vault utility). Only decrypted in memory when making courier API calls. No plain-text in logs.
acceptance: Keys encrypted in DB; audit log for every decrypt; no plain-text leaks in logs (verified by log scanner).

title: Waybill Auto-Generation Worker
desc: Worker triggered on `order_paid` event. Calls appropriate courier via adapter. Stores waybill number + PDF label URL on order. Fires WhatsApp update to customer. Retry with backoff on transient failure; alert admin on repeated failure.
acceptance: Waybill generated within 2 min of payment; PDF downloadable; failures alert admin.

title: Delivery Status Sync Job
desc: Poll each courier API every 15 min for status updates on active shipments. Update our `shipments` table. Emit `delivery_status_changed` event which triggers escrow release logic (A2) + customer WhatsApp update.
acceptance: Statuses accurate within 15 min lag; events fire correctly; escrow release chain works end-to-end.

title: Domain Registrar Reseller API Integration
desc: Wholesale API integration with OpenSRS (or equivalent). Operations: check availability (bulk), register, transfer, renew, update contact, manage DNS, unlock/lock. Handles balance monitoring on our reseller account.
acceptance: Real domain registered in sandbox; DNS management works; balance monitored + alerts.

title: In-App Domain Search + Purchase Flow (Backend)
desc: Vendor-facing endpoint that hits registrar's availability API + adds our platform markup (config per TLD). Purchase endpoint: charges wallet → registers via registrar → creates `domains` row → triggers auto-DNS-mapping.
acceptance: Availability check <500ms with markup; purchase creates domain in <30s; failed registrations rollback wallet.

title: Auto-DNS Mapping to Vercel + SSL
desc: After domain purchase, programmatically set A record (or CNAME/ALIAS for apex) pointing to Vercel via Vercel Domains API. Trigger SSL provisioning. Verify DNS propagation before marking domain 'live'.
acceptance: Domain accessible with SSL within 30 min; verified state transition; failures show clear reason.

title: Domain Renewal + Auto-Renewal Engine
desc: Cron: 30 days before expiry email vendor + attempt wallet auto-charge if auto-renew on. Repeat at 15 days, 3 days. Grace period 7 days after expiry — domain stays live but warned. After grace: registrar handles suspension.
acceptance: Reminders fire on schedule; auto-renew works when wallet has funds; grace period visible to vendor.

title: A3 Test Suite — Logistics + Domains
desc: Integration tests for each courier adapter (mocked APIs). E2E: vendor buys domain → DNS auto-configured → their store accessible on that domain within 30 min.
acceptance: Adapter tests all green; E2E completes in <30 min.

title: Email Template Management (Admin)
desc: /admin/emails: CRUD for platform-wide email templates. Preview with sample data. Version history. A/B test setup UI.
acceptance: Templates editable; preview accurate; version rollback works.

title: Email Analytics Dashboard
desc: /admin/email-analytics: platform-wide email metrics — delivery rate, bounce rate, spam complaint rate, open rate, click rate. By template + by vendor. Alerts if deliverability drops.
acceptance: Metrics render accurately from Resend webhooks; alerts trigger.

title: Security & Audit Panel
desc: /admin/security: audit log viewer (searchable, filterable by actor/resource/action), active admin sessions, failed login attempts, RLS policy status per table.
acceptance: Log searchable across 1M+ entries; session revoke works.

title: System Health & Cost Dashboard
desc: /admin/system: real-time system health (Vercel status, Supabase health, Cloudinary usage, LLM API cost today, error rate). Cost projection to end of month. Alerts on abnormal spend.
acceptance: Metrics live; cost projections accurate within 5%; alerts fire.

title: AI Usage & Cost Monitor
desc: /admin/ai-usage: track LLM + image gen usage per vendor + per feature (theme rebrand, ad copy, WhatsApp AI, product copy, image gen). Flag runaway usage. Suggest optimizations.
acceptance: Usage tracked accurately; flags fire; optimization suggestions shown.

title: Resend Integration + Custom Domain Auto-Verification
desc: Wire Resend API. When a vendor adds a custom domain, programmatically add SPF, DKIM, DMARC records via A3's DNS mapping, verify with Resend, mark vendor as 'branded email ready'. Fall back to platform-branded sender if unverified.
acceptance: Auto-verification works within 30 min; emails send from vendor domains; deliverability >95%.

title: React Email Template System + Sending Pipeline
desc: React Email components for all transactional templates (order confirmation, shipping, delivery, refund, subscription reminder, password reset, invite, low-stock, abandoned cart 3-touch sequence). Per-vendor branding injected. Send pipeline with retry, rate limiting, suppression list respect.
acceptance: All 10+ templates render; branding correct; retries work; suppression respected.

title: Abandoned Cart 3-Touch Sequence Worker
desc: Consumes `cart_abandoned` event. Sends touch 1 at +1h, touch 2 at +24h with 5% coupon, touch 3 at +72h with 10% coupon. Cancels sequence if customer completes purchase.
acceptance: Sequence fires correctly; cancellation on purchase works; conversion measurable.

title: RLS Policies Across All Tables
desc: Design and enforce Row Level Security policies on EVERY Supabase table so that: (a) vendor A cannot read/write vendor B's data; (b) customer A cannot read customer B's data on the same vendor; (c) admin can bypass with proper role. Write test suite that tries cross-tenant access on every table.
acceptance: Every table has RLS; penetration test finds no cross-tenant leaks; test suite catches regressions.

title: Cryptographic Key Vault Utility Library
desc: Shared library for encrypting/decrypting sensitive fields: courier API keys (used by A3), payment gateway keys, VCC PANs, OAuth tokens. AES-256-GCM. Master key in Vercel env / KMS. Rotation supported.
acceptance: Library used by A3, V4, A2, A4; keys rotatable; every decrypt audit-logged.

title: Rate Limiting + Bot Protection
desc: Rate limits on every public endpoint (login, signup, storefront APIs). Cloudflare/Vercel-level for DDoS. reCAPTCHA v3 on signup/login when suspicious. IP-based rate limits + user-based.
acceptance: Malicious floods blocked at edge; legitimate users unaffected; captcha invisible when normal.

title: Shared AI Service (WhatsApp AI + Meta Ads AI)
desc: Core AI service consumed by V-side. WhatsApp AI: multi-turn conversation with product catalog context; understands intent (price, availability, order); triggers order creation via V4; hands off to human when stuck. Meta Ads AI: generates ad copy variants + suggests targeting.
acceptance: Both services work end-to-end; average latency <5s; token cost tracked per call; graceful fallback on LLM failure.

title: WhatsApp Business Cloud API Integration
desc: Register vendor phone numbers via Meta's Cloud API. Send/receive messages (text, media, templates). Template approval workflow. Delivery tracking. Handles opt-in/opt-out.
acceptance: Real messages flow both ways; templates approved by Meta; delivery + read receipts tracked.

title: Vercel CI/CD Pipeline + Env Management
desc: GitHub → Vercel: PR deploys to preview URL, main deploys to production. Env vars managed via Vercel + synced to dev machines via CLI. Rollback via 1-click. Deploy hooks for M-team notifications.
acceptance: PR previews work; prod deploys atomic (0 downtime); rollback tested; env vars secure.

title: Monitoring, Logging & Alerting Stack
desc: Sentry for JS/backend errors (per-project). Structured log drain to Axiom/BetterStack. Uptime monitoring every 60s. PagerDuty rotation for P0 alerts (escrow failures, payment failures, DB down).
acceptance: Errors caught; alerts within 5 min of P0; on-call rotation set.

title: Cost Tracking + Budget Alerts
desc: Daily job pulls costs from Vercel, Supabase, Cloudinary, Resend, LLM providers. Store in `cost_tracking` table. Alert if daily cost > budget threshold. Feed A2's financial reports.
acceptance: Costs pulled daily; alerts fire; A2's reports match.

title: A4 Test Suite — Security + AI + Infra
desc: Security: automated RLS tests (attempt cross-tenant every table). AI: mock conversation tests for WhatsApp AI. Infra: chaos tests (DB failover, LLM outage).
acceptance: RLS suite passes 100%; AI conversation quality manually reviewed and scored; chaos scenarios recovered.
